steps.title: Analyze and configure 3D aesthetic parameters
steps.description: Formulate 3D physical extrusion visual layout guidelines using layered shape drawables for modern skeuomorphic depth.

steps.title: Build tactile 3D card layout backgrounds
steps.description: Construct high-fidelity 3D card XML layer-lists with deep shadow offsets and distinct top/bottom edge gradients.

steps.title: Build responsive 3D physical button background selector
steps.description: Define normal and pressed state buttons in XML that actively push down into the canvas shadow depth upon tactile user interaction.

steps.title: Build secondary action 3D green button background
steps.description: Develop a specialized green variant of the 3D tactile button background to accentuate successful completion states and positive triggers.

steps.title: Implement dynamic audio tone synthesizer
steps.description: Build custom AudioTrack PCM wave synthesizers directly within MainActivity to play rich multi-tone sound effects without heavy external binary media files.

steps.title: Integrate interactive sound effects on click events
steps.description: Connect synthesized physical click tones to tab layout selections, header quick-add button triggers, and standard system operations.

steps.title: Integrate audio notifications on database changes
steps.description: Bind successful addition melodies to subject, task, and alarm creation workflows, and deep warning pitches to item cancellations.

steps.title: Construct the welcome 'Leader' splash overlay
steps.description: Create a fully stylized 3D welcome splash dialogue greeting users with motivational leadership statements and a sequence of pleasant chimes upon launch.

steps.title: Refine main activity XML layout alignment
steps.description: Modify padding attributes and margins across major dashboard panels to cleanly display the deep skeuomorphic card elevations and remove invalid stroke attributes from the bottom navigation LinearLayout.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 compile compatibility and layout structures
steps.description: Audit all source components to guarantee traditional anonymous inner classes are used and verify exact xml namespace declarations.

steps.title: Building Student Study Planner
steps.description: Run standard Gradle debug packaging builds to output the modified application.
